headline: Nobody is accused.
sub: The ring says "it's been a while" — never "you weren't there".
content:
The long silences in families rarely come from not caring. They come from everyone assuming someone else went.

GranWatch doesn't accuse anyone. It says one kind thing — it's been a while; who can go this week? — and anyone in the family can be the one who turns it green.

Grace, not guilt. For those who truly care. granwatch.app
notes: Belief 3: grace not guilt. Tier-1 badge line closes.
